rating.comments: The first message is the pasted task question and is ignored. The student gives reasons: 'if you dont do something like they do you will get bullyed' and 'they will always need to think for how could they look good', plus a weighed two-sided view ('It might help them because... a good way to build connections'). Later, 'if somebody is carrefull he will join a group of peaple that he thurst' adds a condition. No earlier content is revised or extended, and no questions are asked. Five persistent, task-focused messages show sustained, self-directed work.
